However, I treated d as an arbitrary divisor of 1400, but c and d are not independent: c=gcd(lcm(x,y),z) divides z, and z divides lcm(gcd(x,y),z)=d, so c|d. Therefore c² divides 1400, not just c.
Next, I should enforce c|d, find the largest c such that c² divides 1400, and exhibit natural numbers x,y,z achieving it.
